text.content:
Castlemarch faction notes

Castlemarch is based on Constantinople and the Byzantine Empire.

The rulers of Castlemarch are Lord Malon [human] and Lady Amarille
[human] (Possible dragon? In polymorph?)

The Lord and Lady are generally hidden away in their various palaces in
the city, rarely interacting with the public at large. Governance is
done by lesser officers and nobles managing the various departments of
the city’s bureaucracy.

Sitting on the strait of spears, the city has grown wealthy with trade
between the SSE, Wolfsgard, the Elves, and the Arnieans to the south.
The Arnieans have traded rare perfumes, spices, and other materials in
exchange for the finely worked items from the Dwarves and Elves. The
Arnieans have also had a trade in slaves, although this has diminished
in recent decades with reforms in the slave laws put into place by Lord
Malon. War / raiding captives are still the primary source of slaves,
sometimes ransomed back to the Arnieans or put to work in various
pursuits (fields, labor). Highly skilled slaves have found positions of
authority and responsibility in Castlemarch society, often controlling
significant assets and overseeing significant operations / businesses.

Some of these people may be eunuchs or were sold into slavery by their
parents to pay debts. Some may have sold themselves into slavery to
improve their economic position. Slaves, especially non war captive
slaves, can buy or otherwise achieve their freedom after sometime,
depending on their circumstances.

General city laws:

- Weapons greater than a dagger must be peace bonded or left with the
town guard upon entry.

Members of certain orders and/or with enough reputation with the city
may be permitted to carry unbonded weapons in the city.

- War golems are not permitted inside the city

- Offensive magic is not permitted in the city (except for the town
guard and certain nobles/orders).

- Unsanctioned magic use inside the city is punishable by death

- Illusion magic used to deceive in trade or official matters is
punishable by imprisonment and/or death

Thieves’ Guild (Castlemarch)

The TG is tied into the various nobles and administration centers. Their
bread and butter is moving goods in and out of the docks and and
exporting to other parts of Etesia. They have some relations with
contact in Arniea to source materials to/from there. They work with the
internal security/police, and are tolerated by IP as long as they
cooperate.
